claims.text: Resmetirom (thyroid beta-receptor agonist) for MASH w mod-severe (F2-F3) fibrosis reversed steatosis and MASH in 30% and improved fibrosis in 25% in a randomized trial;
claims.quote: Resmetirom, a thyroid beta receptor agonist, can be used to treat patients with MASLD and moderate to severe (F2 and F3) fibrosis (5). In a randomized trial, resmetirom use led to reversal of steatosis and MASH in 30% of patients and improvement in fibrosis by at least one stage in 25% of patients

claims.text: MC SE are diarrhea and nausea.
claims.quote: Clinical trials have demonstrated good tolerance and adverse effect profile (most commonly diarrhea and nausea).

claims.text: Preliminary evidence: TZDs and vit E can help correct biochem and histologic abnormalities but may ⍉reduce fibrosis;
claims.quote: Preliminary evidence suggests that thiazolidinediones and vitamin E can help correct biochemical and histologic abnormalities in MASH, but may not reduce fibrosis

claims.text: vit E (800 IU/day) suggested for nondiabetic MASH w stage 2+ fibrosis.
claims.quote: Vitamin E is suggested for patients with MASH (stage 2 fibrosis or above) who do not have diabetes at a dosage of 800 IU daily.
